scoreDescription: Score = citationWeight × citationSignal + reputationWeight × reputationSignal. Citation weight rises linearly from 0 at release to 1 at 24 months; reputation weight is its complement. Citation signal = min(100, citations × 100 / 100000). Reputation uses the strongest sourced company affiliation, curated author, or publication-linked author h-index / 100, scaled to 100; signals do not stack. Missing signals remain unknown and their weights are not reassigned. Category cutoffs are recalibrated toward 650 visible papers. Historical selections, protected foundations and reviewed recent learning contributions remain available; recent nodes require a citation or curated prerequisite connection.
